d.t: REFLECTIVE MARKER FOR GRASS AND GRAVEL PAVER MODULES
d.s: SikaRoof TurfPave Reflector is a reflective road marker designed to demarcate emergency vehicle accessways on permeable and green pathways. Reflective road marker housing units are manufactured from polypropylene (PP) and raise reflective road markers to increase visibility. SikaRoof TurfPave Reflector modules are push-fitted into any cell on SikaRoof TurfPave XD.
a: Uses the standard 100 mm x 100 mm reflective roadway markers
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Reflective road markers are used as traffic guides for emergency vehicles and restrict encroachment into designated emergency zones.
d.pk: SikaRoof TurfPave Reflector Refer to pricelist

sec.t: Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No. SGBP 3255
No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

Product must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements

SikaRoof TurfPave Reflector shall be fitted with a 100 x 100 mm reflective road marker secured by two screws and nuts. The module would then be push-fitted into pre-determined cells of SikaRoof TurfPave XD to create the desired design according to specifications.
